SURESH BABU S Senior IAM Program, Project & Delivery Manager | Cloud & Cybersecurity Transformation PMP | CISM | Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) | Agile & Scrum Delivery | Program & Portfolio Management Bengaluru, India | +91 9600037070 | sureshbabu.chn@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/sureshbabusanthanaraj

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Program, Project, and Delivery Manager with 18+ years leading enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud, and cybersecurity transformation programs across global banking and telecommunications organizations. Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar, multi-workstream IAM and infrastructure portfolios (up to USD 5.5M) spanning 60+ countries, 95,000+ users, and matrixed teams of 25+ engineers, architects, and vendor partners.

Deep hands-on expertise in IAM platform delivery — Microsoft Entra ID, SSO/MFA, SAML 2.0/OIDC, Zero Trust, Conditional Access, and passwordless authentication — combined with Agile/Scrum delivery (Azure DevOps, Jira), PMO governance, steering committee and executive reporting, change management and benefits realization, and risk/regulatory compliance (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST). Recognized for translating technical and architectural decisions into measurable business outcomes — cost optimization, delivery predictability, and risk reduction. Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), and Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certified.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Delivered enterprise cloud, identity, and cybersecurity transformation programs representing USD 8.7M+ in combined portfolio value across 60+ countries and 95,000+ users.

Realized approximately USD 825K in cost savings through vendor consolidation and delivery process optimization over 5 years.

Reduced legacy authentication exceptions by 40% and password-related support incidents by 35% through Zero Trust and passwordless authentication initiatives.

Closed 30+ audit observations across SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and NIST engagements within regulatory timelines, with zero compliance escalations.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Program & Portfolio Leadership: Enterprise Program & Portfolio Management · PMO Governance & Steering Committee Reporting · Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management · Change Management & Benefits Realization

Identity & Access Management (IAM): Identity & Access Management (IAM) Program Delivery · Microsoft Entra ID · SSO/MFA · SAML 2.0/OIDC · Zero Trust & Conditional Access · Passwordless Authentication (Windows Hello for Business) · Identity Lifecycle Management · Active Directory & Hybrid Identity

Agile Delivery & Tools: Agile & Scrum Delivery · Azure DevOps · Jira · Confluence · Sprint & Backlog Management · Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

Architecture & Technical Leadership: Architecture Reviews & Solution Design Governance · Cloud Platform Transformation (Azure) · Enterprise Application Integration & Onboarding (1,000+ Apps)

Governance, Risk & Compliance: Program Governance · Risk & Dependency Management · SOX · PCI DSS · ISO 27001 · NIST · Audit Readiness & Remediation

Financial & Vendor Management: Program Budgeting & Forecasting · Staffing & Capacity Planning · Vendor & Contract Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Career progression from hands-on network engineering into enterprise technical delivery and program leadership, with increasing scope, budget, and stakeholder accountability over 18+ years.

IAM Project Manager | Information & Cybersecurity Services | Standard Chartered Global Business Services, Bengaluru, India

Jun 2020 – Present

Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud, and cybersecurity transformation programs supporting 95,000+ employees across 60 countries; direct

integration feasibility assessments and onboarding of 1,000+ enterprise applications to Microsoft Entra ID using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC).

Own a USD 3.2M multi-workstream program portfolio, managing integrated roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, staffing, and vendor/contract resources across a matrixed team of 25+ engineers, security architects, and vendor partners.

Drive Agile and Scrum delivery using Azure DevOps and Jira for backlog management, sprint tracking, and delivery reporting, and Confluence for program documentation and governance artifacts; serve as Interim Product Owner for an 8-member cross-functional Agile squad, sustaining 90%+ sprint completion rates.

Serve on architecture review boards and lead solution design discussions for identity platform integrations, providing technical governance input that shaped Conditional Access and Zero Trust design decisions.

Established PMO governance structures, steering committee reporting, change management processes, and RAID/risk tracking across engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and vendor teams; serve as primary liaison to executive, security, and business stakeholders on program status and decision-making.

Directed Conditional Access policy design aligned with Zero Trust strategy, reducing legacy authentication exceptions by 40% while maintaining 95%+ policy compliance; led the global Windows Hello for Business and passwordless authentication rollout, cutting password-related support incidents by 35% and achieving 98%+ authentication success.

Partnered with Internal Audit, Risk, and Compliance teams to meet SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and NIST requirements, closing 30+ audit observations within agreed regulatory timelines with zero compliance escalations. Apr 2010 – Jun 2020

Technical Delivery Manager | Singtel Global India Pvt. Ltd., Chennai, India

Managed a USD 5.5M enterprise infrastructure and Identity and Access Management (IAM) transformation program portfolio across APAC, leading Active Directory consolidation and hybrid identity initiatives that enabled cloud adoption and SSO across a distributed team of 30+ engineers and vendor resources.

Established PMO governance, SLA management, risk/dependency tracking, and executive reporting frameworks across 12+ cross-functional delivery teams spanning 8 APAC countries, improving delivery predictability and stakeholder visibility.

Partnered with architecture and engineering leads on solution design and technical governance for identity and infrastructure integration projects, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards.

Managed program budgets and led vendor consolidation and delivery process improvements, delivering USD 825K in cost savings over 5 years.

Served as primary stakeholder liaison between application, infrastructure, and security teams, translating business requirements into technical delivery plans.

Engineering & Technology Roles | Tata Teleservices · ZTE Global India · Shivani Info Solutions, India

2006 – 2010

Delivered telecom core network projects — routing optimization, capacity planning, and automated provisioning — improving service reliability by 28%, and developed SOPs and technical runbooks that strengthened operational readiness across network operations teams.

CERTIFICATIONS

Project Management Professional (PMP) · Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) · Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) · ITIL 4 · AWS Solutions Architect · Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) – Electronics & Communications Engineering, 2005 Anna University, Chennai, India

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Best Performer Award, Standard Chartered (2026) – Recognized for leading the enterprise-wide MFA and Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) deployment, delivering secure passwordless authentication to 95,000+ users across the bank. • Security Champion Award, Singtel (2019) – Recognized for outstanding contribution to enterprise security and

risk management initiatives.
